note: Copy outside the repository and keep it untracked. endpoint is an EXISTING OpenCodex service started and owned by the operator; this module never starts, stops, restarts or reconfigures it. adminTokenEnv names the environment variable holding the service's MANAGEMENT (admin) credential — a different credential from any data-plane/proxy admission key and from the Codex app-server token. The token itself never appears in this file, in bridge output, in a Task/Operation, or in diagnostics.
